raw.title: Nasir Khusraw
raw.description: 11th-century Persian Isma'ili poet, scholar, philosopher, and missionary
raw.extract: Abu Mo'in Nasir ibn Khusraw ibn Harith Qubodiyani Balkhi, known as Nasir Khusraw, was an Persian-speaking Isma'ili poet, philosopher, traveler, and missionary for the Isma'ili Fatimid Caliphate. He was born in Qubodiyon, Khorasan and died in Yamgan, Badakhshan. His resting place is in Balkh, Afghanistan.
